question: What does registration revision 3 specify that the pilot never used?

specified.note: 13 coefficients incl. c0 + deltas + delta-deltas, librosa, 25 ms window / 10 ms hop. Features with no learned structure.

Run in the span grid's pooled design (2026-10-29), on the 10,334 sites under joint: best layer 9 on every span, balanced accuracy 0.616–0.625. Ahead of MFCC on every span (C5). Index 0 is not the CNN output but LayerNorm(projection + positional conv), so it carries position (span grid §8).
Index 0 is the input to the first layer; 1–12 are layer outputs. Pretraining data not yet checked against the paper.

answer:
Of the items registration revision 3 specifies, the only one the pilot never used is the exploratory representation **facebook/wav2vec2-base** [rep-wav2vec2]. It is marked as used, but only by the representation-communities run and the span grid, not by the pilot [rep-wav2vec2].

When it was run, in the span grid's pooled design on 10,334 sites under the joint condition, its best layer was 9 on every span. Balanced accuracy was 0.616–0.625, ahead of MFCC on every span [rep-wav2vec2]. The note adds that its index 0 is LayerNorm(projection + positional conv) rather than the CNN output, so it carries position information [rep-wav2vec2].

Every other specified item lists the pilot among its users:
- the joint, random, speaker-disjoint and word-disjoint conditions [cond-joint, cond-random, cond-speaker, cond-word]
- the word-lookup baseline and the control task [ctrl-lookup, task-control]
- the [ɾ] environment [env-flap]
- max, mean and midpoint pooling [pool-max, pool-mean, pool-midpoint]
- the linear probe [probe-linear]
- the MFCC and WavJEPA representations [rep-mfcc, rep-wavjepa]
- the speaker-ID and voicing tasks [task-speaker, task-voicing]

This answer covers only the items returned in these rows. If revision 3 specifies other items that weren't retrieved, they aren't reflected here.
